units: metres, root space at rest, feet at y 0, front -z (boxes: c = centre, h = half size). `local` = the joint's own frame at unit scale

lines.note: the hydraulic lines under his skin (material pj_lines: the game can pulse it)

plates.note: scar tissue grown over armour plate (pj_scar), rivets and one bare corner

towel.note: the soup-stained tea towel in his back pocket

cock.note: the cocking collar: slides +y (up the arm) 0.040 to cock

fist.note: his knuckles: bare steel, the skin worn off them

ram.note: the chrome ram and wrist cuff: move handR -y by up to 0.24 and the fist rides out on it

dmgLockL.note: armour broken: the shin lock blown, the gland weeping

lockL.note: the shin lock: a toggle lever, modelled open; turn it `shut` rad about z and it slaps up flat against the sleeve

shinL.note: a shin piston: red sleeve, chrome rod, down the front of the leg to the boot's guard

dmgLockR.note: armour broken: the shin lock blown, the gland weeping

lockR.note: the shin lock: a toggle lever, modelled open; turn it `shut` rad about z and it slaps up flat against the sleeve

shinR.note: a shin piston: red sleeve, chrome rod, down the front of the leg to the boot's guard

boiler.note: the boiler: a beer keg sunk in his lower back (RETURN EMPTY), fire door, level glass, manifold

collar.note: the welded steel collarbone (the weld is to his right of centre)

dmgArm.note: the severed length of the arm, still through him (front stub, the hand out of his back)

dmgBoilerSplit.note: the boiler split where the arm came out of it: petals, cracks lit from inside (pj_core)

dmgCollar.note: armour broken: the collarbone weld sprung, his right half of the bar standing out of him

dmgMarrow.note: marrow taken: the keg opened from behind, his lower spine in it with a gap (pj_marrow glows)

dmgStackL.note: armour broken: the stack bent over

dmgStackR.note: armour broken: the stack bent over

dmgWound.note: the hole under his ribs: lip, torn singlet, the soak down to his belt

fire.note: what glows: the fire door slots (pj_glow) and the level glass (pj_marrow)

flapL.note: its rain cap: hinged about `axis`, + opens it (about 1.2 rad is wide open)

flapR.note: its rain cap: hinged about `axis`, + opens it (about 1.2 rad is wide open)

gauge.note: the pressure gauge (its face is pj_dial)

kegSeat.note: where the boiler goes into him: the singlet cut away, raw skin, a welt of scar, six lugs bolted through

needle.note: the gauge needle: turns about `axis` (0 = straight up the dial, + = clockwise as you read it)

stackBase.note: the stacks' sleeves and clamps, the copper manifold

stackL.note: a thruster stack: slides 0.07 along `axis` when the rig comes up

stackR.note: a thruster stack: slides 0.07 along `axis` when the rig comes up

valve.note: the bleed wheel: turns about +y of the spine

valveBody.note: the bleed valve body and spout

vest.note: the hi-vis vest, MARSH DELIVERIES in marker. removable: he gives it to Dumpling

handtruck.note: s_handtruck.glb stands here (root space, metres): its grip is under his left palm. palm height 1.195 (the grip is at 1.17)

seat.note: the top of the rail he sits on is here in his root space: put his root at rail - this

load.note: the middle of a crate about 0.6 m across carried on his forearms

fridge.note: the fridge door is at z = backZ in the root space of where he STOOD when the clip began (he ends sat 0.59 m behind that)

carry.note: root space of the pose: the carrier's arms go under `back` and `knees`. parent his root to the carrier and offset it so these land on their forearms

hand.note: your hand: he reaches to `take`, then holds it at `chest` (his palm over it at palmL)
